notes: Cash basis; Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (pp5-6) Total Governmental Funds column, which nets a 75,000 elimination (Depreciation Fund transfer in vs. General Fund Student transportation 'Property') out of both receipts and disbursements, so top-level transfers are null and Student transportation is 196,750 (271,750 - 75,000). Beginning/ending cash = total governmental fund balances 5,543,582 / 7,041,873 (include due from County Treasurer). Roll-forward: 5,543,582 + 12,319,018 - 10,820,727 = 7,041,873. 'Other local receipts' (984,815) split using the fund budget schedules (General, Depreciation, Employee Benefit, Special Building, Bond) plus the Activity Fund column (304,896, no per-account schedule in the trimmed PDF); 'County receipts' and 'Other non-revenue receipts' split from the General Fund schedule. Statement 'Taxes' = levied property tax only (4,145,128 + 391,582 + 801,502). Business-type: School Nutrition fund (cash measure): 157,365 + 250,893 - 308,965 = 99,293; the USDA and State subsidy 135,358 split federal 133,851 / state 1,507 from p14. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis Total column (p1; no liabilities printed, total_liabilities null). Detail: General Fund expenditures taken from the Supporting Schedule of Cash Disbursements (program x object), which supersedes the function-only lines of the budget schedule (so those lines are not repeated; budget amounts not available by object); General Fund revenue from the budget schedule. Hidden transfer: Student transportation 'Property' 75,000 is shown as an other financing -75,000 line (not as spending); the printed General Fund total 9,152,297 includes it. School object mapping notes: 'Purchased property services' -> repairs and maintenance, 'Other property services' -> professional/contract services, 'Miscellaneous' -> miscellaneous expenditure (review). Activity Fund, Special Education/other fund schedules beyond those listed are not in the trimmed PDF. School Nutrition 'Transfer from general fund' actual is a dash (0) with budget 70,000. Read pages 1-17 of 17
